Class DividendMetricsCalculator

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.reports.DividendMetricsCalculator
public final class DividendMetricsCalculator extends Object
Computes the dividend key figures of one security from its dividends, its price and its closes. It holds no state and touches no repository, so the arithmetic can be tested with hand-made input.

The definitions follow the dividend functions of the watchlist indicator columns (IndicatorFunctionSet), so the box of the dividend feed and an indicator column show the same number: the trailing window covers the ex-dates of the last 365 days, annual sums use calendar years, and the growth rates end with the last completed year.

  • Method Details

    • calculate

      public static SecurityDividendMetrics calculate(String currency, List<DividendMetricsCalculator.DividendPoint> dividends, Double price, Integer paymentsPerYear, List<DividendMetricsCalculator.ClosePoint> closes, Double eps, List<SecurityDividendMetrics.SplitMark> splits, LocalDate today)
      Computes all key figures.
      Parameters:
      currency - the currency of the security
      dividends - the dividends ordered by ex-date ascending, possibly including ex-dates after today
      price - the last price of the security, null when unknown
      paymentsPerYear - the regular number of payments per year of the security, null when it has none
      closes - the closes ordered by date ascending, used for the yield history
      eps - the trailing earnings per share in the currency of the security, null when unknown
      splits - the splits of the security
      today - the day of the request
      Returns:
      the key figures; all figures null and empty lists when no dividend lies on or before today

    • indexBaseYear

      public static Integer indexBaseYear(List<List<SecurityDividendMetrics.YearAmount>> perSecurity, int lastCompletedYear)
      Base year of the dividend index of several securities: the first completed year in which every security with dividends paid for a whole year. The year of the first dividend may be incomplete, so the base is the year after it, taken as the latest over all securities. Securities without dividends do not count.
      Parameters:
      perSecurity - the annual dividends of each security, ascending by year
      lastCompletedYear - the year before the current one
      Returns:
      the base year, or null when it would lie after the last completed year or no security has dividends

    • index

      public static List<SecurityDividendChart.YearValue> index(List<SecurityDividendMetrics.YearAmount> years, Integer baseYear, int lastCompletedYear)
      Annual dividends of the completed years from the base year on, as a percentage of the base year. Being a ratio of amounts in the same currency, the index needs no conversion between the compared securities.
      Parameters:
      years - the annual dividends of one security
      baseYear - the common base year, may be null
      lastCompletedYear - the year before the current one
      Returns:
      the index; empty without base year or when the base year sum is missing or not positive. A year without exchange rate is left out.
